mapper.sql: id, operation_type, operation_desc, operation_param, user_id, user_name, user_type, ip_address, operation_time, execution_time, status, is_deleted, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, COALESCE(SUM(status = 1), 0) AS successCount, COALESCE(SUM(status = 0), 0) AS failCount, ROUND(COUNT(*) / #{days}, 1) AS dailyAvg, AVG(execution_time) AS avgExecutionTime, MAX(operation_time) AS lastOperationTime FROM sys_operation_log WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND operation_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)

SELECT operation_type AS operationType, COUNT(*) AS `count` FROM sys_operation_log WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND operation_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY operation_type ORDER BY `count` DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT user_name AS userName, user_id AS userId, MAX(user_type) AS userType, COUNT(*) AS `count` FROM sys_operation_log WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND operation_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY user_name, user_id ORDER BY `count` DESC

SELECT COALESCE(t.module, '未知') AS moduleName, COUNT(*) AS `count` FROM sys_operation_log l LEFT JOIN sys_operation_type t ON t.type COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci = l.operation_type WHERE l.is_deleted = 0 AND l.operation_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY t.module ORDER BY `count` DESC

mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys_operation_log WHERE is_deleted = 1 OR operation_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
